Package teilchen

Class Physics

java.lang.Object
teilchen.Physics
public class Physics extends Object
particle system that holds particles, forces and constraints and advances them in time.

thread safety: step holds the lock of the particle list for the whole step. adding and removing particles, forces and constraints locks the respective list, so these methods may be called from another thread. iterating the lists returned by particles(), forces() or constraints() from another thread must be done while holding the lock of that list ( synchronized (physics.particles()) {...} ). modifying the particle list from inside a force or constraint during step is not supported.

      public void applyForces(float pDeltaTime, boolean pAccumulateInnerForces)
      applies all active forces. inner forces of particles ( e.g behaviors ) are only accumulated if pAccumulateInnerForces is true. multi-stage integrators accumulate inner forces once per step and then call this method with false for each stage.

    • handleNewParticles

      protected void handleNewParticles()
      particles that have not been stepped yet ( age 0 ) may have been positioned after creation without updating their old position. for integrators that do not derive velocity from the old position ( i.e not Verlet ) the old position is set to the current position, so that colliders and the fixed particle velocity see a valid previous position.

    • collisionOrigin

      public processing.core.PVector collisionOrigin(Particle pParticle)
      start of the path a particle traveled during the current step as seen by colliders. this is old_position() unless a collider already resolved a collision for the particle in this step, in which case it is the contact point. used by colliders so that a particle deflected by one collider is not deflected back by another ( e.g at seams between triangles ).

    • collisionOrigin

      public void collisionOrigin(Particle pParticle, float x, float y, float z)
